notes.title: Announcement: Tokyo Game Show 2025
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558958/cec0177c14d4f872bcdd14737462df8c0e9791b2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We are happy to announce that THE SCREEN will be exhibiting at Tokyo Game Show 2025, held at Makuhari Messe.[/p][p]The game will be playable at our booth UrbanFox, along with the other game we are also developing now, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2283820/"]DRIFTED[/url].[/p][p]As a finalist of the GAME PRIZE OF JAPAN, THE SCREEN will also be exhibited at the organizer's booth.[/p][p]In addition to the gameplay, we are also showcasing some postcards. Be sure to check them out![/p][hr][/hr][h2]Booth Information[/h2][p][/p][p]THE SCREEN demo is playable at 2 booths:[/p][list][*][p][b]UrbanFox[/b] | 11-C09[/p][/*][*][p][b]GAME PRIZE OF JAPAN[/b] | Organizer's Booth[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Tokyo Game Show 2025 - Information[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Event Website[/b][/p][p][url="https://tgs.cesa.or.jp/en"]https://tgs.cesa.or.jp/en[/url][/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Event Dates[/b][/p][list][*][p]Business Days:[/p][list][*][p]September 25th (THU) 10:00 – 17:00[/p][/*][*][p]September 26th (FRI) 10:00 – 17:00[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Public Days: [/p][list][*][p]September 27th (SAT) 9:30 – 17:00[/p][/*][*][p]September 28th (SUN) 9:30 – 16:30[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]About UrbanFox[/h2][p][/p][p]UrbanFox is a game developer with multiple awards and exhibition experiences internationally, including gamescom, Tokyo Game Show, the Japan iGi indie Game incubator Special Award, the Bahamut ACG Creation Contest Gold Award, and more.[/p][p]They are currently developing DRIFTED and THE SCREEN.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][/p]
